implementation_notes: Preserved Load(io.Reader) ([]Record, error), Record's exported fields, order, first '=' splitting, empty fields and literal whitespace/carriage-return behavior.
Added exported *LineError with Line and Text, retaining the previous human-readable malformed-record message.
Ignored empty lines and lines beginning with '#' while retaining physical line numbers.
Retained io.ReadAll to avoid introducing a scanner line cap. Parsed all retained bytes even when the reader returned an independent failure.
Returned a direct *LineError for parse-only failures and errors.Join(LineError, readErr) for independent parse/read failures. Successful completion returns a nil error interface.

Added external-package contract tests for valid records, comments, empty input/fields, literal bytes, a 128 KiB line, exact error fields, omitted records after malformed input, read failure before/after/alongside bytes, EOF alongside valid/malformed bytes, wrapped non-comparable typed reader causes and borrowed-reader ownership.
Added a runnable ExampleLoad and concise README/Godoc covering error inspection, prefix retention, parsing rules, reader ownership and buffering.
No dependencies, Go version changes, Git commits, installations or external actions.
